name: subagent-band
description: A band above the prompt with each running subagent's type, model, effort, steps, context, advisor calls and estimated cost; a /fleet pane, /steer, /subagent-cost, and a subagent_vitals tool for the model

priceTable.title: Model prices per million tokens
priceTable.description: Comma-separated family:input:output in USD, such as opus:4:20, sonnet:2:10, haiku:1:5, fable:10:50. A model id is matched by containing the family name; one that matches none is priced as the first entry. Used for the cost estimates only.

cacheWriteMultiplier.title: Cache write price (times the input price)
cacheWriteMultiplier.description: What a prompt-cache write costs relative to input tokens.

cacheReadMultiplier.title: Cache read price (times the input price)
cacheReadMultiplier.description: What a prompt-cache read costs relative to input tokens.
